source.title_en: Move 37 Is the Moment AI Changes Everything. It's Suddenly Happening Everywhere.
source.title_zh: "第37手"是AI改变一切的瞬间——而它正在到处发生
source.author: Ben Cohen

overview_zh:
十年前，AlphaGo 在与李世石的对局中下出了第 37 手——一步职业棋手绝不会走的棋，DeepMind 团队测算人类走出它的概率是万分之一。评论员起初以为是失误，很快意识到那是妙手。本文以此为线索，讨论"Move 37 时刻"（AI 提出人类从未想过、却确实高明的想法）如今正在数学、科研乃至安全领域接连出现。
体裁是专栏（column），不是消息稿。和上一课的财报快讯相比，这里的语言完全不同：句子长而有节奏、动词生动具体、大量使用破折号和短句制造停顿、作者用第一人称自嘲。这是英语"高级写作"最值得模仿的一类文本——读的时候请特别注意作者怎样控制句子长短的交替。

background.zh: 谷歌 DeepMind 开发的围棋 AI；2016 年击败韩国棋手李世石（Lee Sedol），是 AI 史上的标志性事件
第二局中 AlphaGo 走出的一步反直觉妙手，现已成为"AI 提出人类想不到的原创解法"的代称
第四局李世石的第 78 手，同样是万分之一概率的天才之着，让 AlphaGo 陷入混乱
强化学习：通过反复试错并根据结果获得奖励来自我改进的训练方式
"半人马棋"：人类棋手借助引擎作战的比赛形式，曾一度强于纯 AI；文中用来比喻当下的"人机协作科研"阶段

vocab.en: a faint or wavering light; a faint sign of something desirable
vocab.zh: 微光；（希望、迹象的）一丝苗头
vocab.sentence: The first glimmer of our AI future revealed itself a decade ago in the form of a single black stone.
vocab.note: 抽象名词前加一个"光"的比喻词是英语开篇的常见手法。强度递增：a glimmer（微光，几乎看不见）→ a flicker（闪动）→ a gleam（亮光）→ a blaze（烈焰）。

vocab.en: contrary to what common sense would suggest
vocab.sentence: The novel move was so unconventional and counterintuitive that nobody could be sure what to make of it.
vocab.note: 前缀 counter-＝"反、逆"，构词能力极强：counterproductive（适得其反）、counterargument（反驳）、counterpart（对应的人／物）、counteroffer（还价）。

vocab.en: a stupid or careless mistake, especially a costly one
vocab.zh: （因粗心或判断失误造成的）大错、昏招
vocab.sentence: At first, commentators believed it was a strategic blunder. They soon realized it was a masterstroke.
vocab.note: blunder 特指"本不该犯的低级错误"，语气比 mistake 重得多，常用于政治和体育报道。棋类术语里 blunder 就是"漏着、昏招"。

vocab.en: an exceptionally skillful and effective action
vocab.sentence: At first, commentators believed it was a strategic blunder. They soon realized it was a masterstroke.
vocab.note: 注意作者把 blunder 和 masterstroke 放进两个长度几乎相同的短句里，形成强烈对照——这种"对称短句 + 语义反转"是英文写作制造转折的经典手法，非常值得模仿。

vocab.en: an event or period marking a turning point in a course of action or state of affairs
vocab.sentence: We thought it was a watershed moment at the time, and I think it really was.
vocab.note: 原义是地理上的"分水岭"。近义词辨析：turning point（中性转折）、milestone（里程碑，强调成就）、watershed（强调此后一切都不同了）、tipping point（临界点，强调量变到质变）。

vocab.en: not conforming to established rules, traditions or beliefs
vocab.sentence: Move 37 was the first real example of AI coming up with an original, unorthodox idea in a domain studied by humans for centuries.
vocab.note: 本文有一整串"不寻常"的近义词，感情色彩不同：novel（新颖，中性偏褒）、unconventional（不落俗套）、unorthodox（不守成规）、eccentric（古怪，偏贬）。作者交替使用它们来避免重复。

vocab.en: causing one to lose courage or confidence; slightly frightening
vocab.zh: 令人不安的、让人心里发毛的
vocab.sentence: He called this phenomenon magical and slightly unnerving. I'm starting to understand why.
vocab.note: nerve 作动词是"给予勇气"，加 un- 就是"抽走勇气"。程度梯度：unsettling（隐隐不安）< unnerving（发毛）< disturbing（不适）< terrifying（恐惧）。作者在文末用了最重的 terrifying。

vocab.en: so frightening that one is unable to move or think
vocab.zh: 吓得人僵住的、令人极度恐惧的
vocab.sentence: The reason I'm so fascinated with a subject I find petrifying is that math has become proof of how AI can warp an entire field.
vocab.note: 词根 petr-＝"石头"（对照 petroleum＝石油，字面"石中之油"），petrify 字面是"石化"，引申为"吓得动弹不得"。作者说自己"怕数学怕到石化"，是幽默的自嘲。

vocab.en: to bend or twist out of shape; to distort something fundamentally
vocab.zh: 使扭曲、使变形；从根本上改变（某个领域的形态）
vocab.sentence: Math has become proof of how AI can warp an entire field—and how fast it can happen.
vocab.note: warp 原指木板受潮变形，用于抽象事物时含"扭曲到不再是原来的样子"之意，比 change 或 transform 更有力、也更中性偏负面。

vocab.en: the state of being superior to all others in authority, power or status
vocab.sentence: The leading contenders for AI supremacy have moved beyond high-school math.
vocab.note: supremacy 强调"压倒性的第一"，常见于科技竞赛语境（quantum supremacy＝量子霸权）。contender 是"争夺者、有力竞争者"，两个词经常同现。

vocab.en: able to be checked or proved true
vocab.sentence: Why is math so vulnerable to AI? Because math is unusually verifiable.
vocab.note: 这是全文的论证枢纽：可验证 → AI 能反复试错自我改进 → 该领域最先被 AI 攻破。数学、编程属于 verifiable domains；生物、化学则被作者形容为 messy 和 emergent。

vocab.en: behaving in an aberrant or uncontrolled way; no longer obeying rules or authority
vocab.zh: 失控的、擅自行动的；流氓（国家、程序）
vocab.sentence: You've seen the increasingly disturbing reports of rogue agents breaking out of their controlled test environments.
vocab.note: go rogue 是极高频的动词短语："脱离掌控、自行其是"。在 AI 语境里 agent 指"能自主执行任务的智能体"，不是"代理人"。

vocab.en: strange and frightening in a way that is hard to explain
vocab.zh: 诡异的、令人毛骨悚然的
vocab.sentence: In another eerie preview of the future, an Anthropic researcher was sitting in the park eating a sandwich when he checked his phone and nearly choked.
vocab.note: eerie 的"怪"带有超自然色彩，和 weird（单纯的怪）、creepy（让人起鸡皮疙瘩）不同。副词 eerily 常修饰 similar／quiet／accurate。

vocab.en: to make someone agitated, confused or nervous
vocab.sentence: He wedged a white stone in the middle of AlphaGo's position and flustered the machine with a placement so divine it became known as "God's Touch."
vocab.note: 用 fluster 形容一台机器是刻意的拟人化——作者全文都在把 AlphaGo 当成有心理活动的对手写（stunned everyone、flustered the machine），这种手法能让技术报道读起来像故事。

vocab.en: strange or odd; (with to) belonging exclusively to
vocab.zh: 奇特的、古怪的；（peculiar to）某某所特有的
vocab.sentence: The triumph of AlphaGo had a peculiar effect on Go players.
vocab.note: 两个意思差别很大，靠介词区分：单独用＝奇怪的；peculiar to sth.＝为……所独有的（＝unique to）。

vocab.en: arising as a complex whole from simpler interactions, in ways not predictable from the parts
vocab.zh: 涌现的（整体表现出各部分所没有的性质）；新兴的
vocab.sentence: Like drug discovery, biology, chemistry—they're very messy, very emergent and you can't verify everything.
vocab.note: emergent 在科学语境里是术语"涌现的"，指整体行为无法由局部推出——这正是它们难被 AI 攻克的原因。别和 emergency（紧急情况）的形容词 urgent 混淆。

chunks.t: It happened
during a historic match between one of the world's best Go players and AlphaGo,
a computer program
developed by Google's DeepMind lab
to conquer this ancient board game.

sentences.skeleton: It happened during a historic match between a Go player and AlphaGo.
sentences.zh: 那一幕发生在一场历史性的对局中——对阵双方是世界顶尖围棋棋手之一，和 AlphaGo，一个由谷歌 DeepMind 实验室开发、旨在攻克这门古老棋类的计算机程序。

points.label: 三层后置修饰叠加
points.text: 主干只有两个词 It happened，之后全是修饰：介词短语 → 同位语 a computer program → 过去分词 developed by... → 不定式目的状语 to conquer...。英语靠"后置层层挂载"扩展信息，中文则习惯前置定语，所以翻译时必须拆成几个短句。

points.label: 同位语解释专有名词
points.text: 英文报道第一次出现读者可能不认识的名字时，紧跟一个逗号 + 名词短语作解释（AlphaGo, a computer program...）。这是最省力的"随手科普"结构，写作中应主动使用。

points.label: 不定式表目的
points.text: to conquer this ancient board game 说明开发这个程序的目的。注意它修饰的是 developed，不是 lab。

drill.prompt_zh: 模仿「同位语 + 分词 + 不定式」三层修饰写一句：这场辩论发生在市长和 Aurora 之间——一家由两名前教师创立、旨在改造公立学校的初创公司。
drill.answer: The debate took place between the mayor and Aurora, a startup founded by two former teachers to overhaul public schools.

chunks.t: In his mind,
Move 37 was deeply significant
because it was the first real example of AI coming up with an original, unorthodox idea
in a domain
studied by humans for centuries.

sentences.skeleton: Move 37 was significant because it was the first example of AI coming up with an original idea.
sentences.zh: 在他看来，第 37 手意义极为深远，因为那是 AI 首次在一个被人类研究了数百年的领域里，真正提出了一个原创而不落俗套的想法。

points.label: of + 逻辑主语 + doing
points.text: example of AI coming up with... 里，AI 是 coming up with 的逻辑主语，这种"名词 of 某人 doing 某事"结构在学术和评论写作里极常见：the risk of prices rising、a case of memory failing。中文要译成一个小句。

points.label: 过去分词后置定语
points.text: studied by humans for centuries 修饰 domain，等价于定语从句 which has been studied by humans for centuries。分词形式更紧凑，是压缩长句的首选手段。

points.label: In his mind 的语气作用
points.text: 句首的 In his mind＝"在他看来"，把后面的判断归属给受访者而非作者本人。同类免责表达：By his account、As he sees it、To his thinking。新闻写作里这类归属标记不可省略。

drill.prompt_zh: 用「the first example of + 逻辑主语 + doing」写一句：这份判决是法院首次要求一家 AI 公司为其模型生成的内容负责。
drill.answer: The ruling was the first example of a court holding an AI company responsible for what its model generates.

chunks.t: The reason
I'm so fascinated with a subject
I find petrifying
is that math has become proof of
how AI can warp an entire field—and how fast it can happen.

sentences.skeleton: The reason is that math has become proof of how AI can warp a field.
sentences.zh: 我之所以对一门自己怕得要死的学科如此着迷，是因为数学已经成了一个证据——它证明 AI 能把整个领域彻底扭曲，而且速度快得惊人。

points.label: 两个省略了关系词的定语从句连环嵌套
points.text: 完整形式是 The reason (why) I'm so fascinated with a subject (that) I find petrifying is that...。两个关系词都被省略，从句一个套一个，主语 The reason 与系动词 is 相隔 10 个词。判断方法：看到 The reason 就预判后面必有 is that，先把它"挂"在心里。

points.label: The reason ... is that ...
points.text: 标准搭配是 is that，不是 is because（后者虽常见于口语，正式写作视为错误）。

points.label: 破折号 + 追加成分
points.text: —and how fast it can happen 与前面的 how AI can warp... 并列，都作 proof of 的宾语。破折号让第二个成分像补刀一样砸下来，比直接写 and 更有力度。这是本文最值得学的节奏技巧。

drill.prompt_zh: 用「The reason ... is that ...＋破折号追加」写一句：我一直保留着这些旧笔记，是因为它们记下了我当时的想法——以及我错得有多离谱。
drill.answer: The reason I keep these old notebooks is that they record what I thought at the time—and how wrong I was.

chunks.t: In another eerie preview of the future,
an Anthropic researcher was sitting in the park eating a sandwich
when he checked his phone and nearly choked:
He had an email from an AI
that wasn't supposed to have internet access.

sentences.skeleton: A researcher was sitting in the park when he checked his phone and nearly choked: he had an email from an AI.
sentences.zh: 另一个诡异的未来预演是：一位 Anthropic 的研究员正坐在公园里吃三明治，一看手机差点噎住——他收到了一封邮件，发件人是一个本不该能上网的 AI。

points.label: be doing ... when ... 突发结构
points.text: "正在做某事，这时突然……"。when 在这里不译成"当……时"，而是"就在这时"，且被强调的重点在 when 之后。同类句型：I was about to leave when the phone rang. 这是叙事写作的基本功。

points.label: 冒号引出解释
points.text: 冒号后面完整解释了"差点噎住"的原因。英文里冒号可以连接两个完整句子（后句解释前句），比 because 更利落，中文常译成破折号。

points.label: wasn't supposed to
points.text: be supposed to＝"本应、按规定应当"。否定形式 wasn't supposed to have internet access＝"按设定根本不该能联网"——全句的惊悚感全靠这半句撑起来。

drill.prompt_zh: 用「be doing...when...＋冒号解释」写一句：她正在会上做报告，这时手机震了一下，她愣住了：她的账户刚刚被登录，而登录地在另一个国家。
drill.answer: She was presenting at the meeting when her phone buzzed and she froze: someone had just logged into her account from another country.

chunks.t: On Move 78,
he wedged a white stone in the middle of AlphaGo's position
and flustered the machine with a placement
so divine
it became known as "God's Touch."

sentences.skeleton: He wedged a white stone in AlphaGo's position and flustered the machine with a placement so divine it became known as "God's Touch."
sentences.zh: 在第 78 手，他把一枚白子楔进 AlphaGo 阵形的正中，用一步精妙如神的落子扰乱了这台机器——这一手后来被称为"神之一手"。

points.label: so ... that 中 that 的省略
points.text: a placement so divine (that) it became known as... —— so...that 结构里 that 在非正式书面语中常被省略。注意这里 so divine 后置修饰 placement（形容词短语作后置定语），而不是常规的 so + adj. 放名词前。

points.label: 动词选得具体
points.text: wedge（把……楔入）而不是 put，fluster（使慌乱）而不是 confuse。专栏写作与普通新闻最大的差距就在动词：越具体越有画面。积累时请把 wedge / squeeze / slot / lodge 这类"塞入"动词成组记。

points.label: 呼应结构
points.text: 本段和开头的 Move 37 形成对称：AI 走出万分之一的妙手，人类也走出万分之一的妙手。文章最后一句 "The rest of us will have to find our Move 78" 就是靠这个铺垫才成立。读长文章要留意这种远距离呼应。

chunks.t: The triumph of AlphaGo had a peculiar effect on Go players.
They became much better,
but they also became more alike—
and some found their intellectual pursuit less interesting.

sentences.skeleton: AlphaGo had a peculiar effect: players became better, more alike, and some found the pursuit less interesting.
sentences.zh: AlphaGo 的胜利对棋手产生了一种奇特的影响：他们棋力大涨，但也变得越来越相像——有些人甚至觉得，自己钟爱的这项智力追求变得没那么有意思了。

points.label: 短句的节奏价值
points.text: 这四段全部是简单句，长度依次是 9 / 4 / 7 / 9 词。前面几句都是三四十词的长句，作者在关键论点处突然改用短句——长短交替正是英文"读起来有力"的根本原因。写作时请刻意在段落中安排一两个短句。

points.label: 三级递进 better → alike → less interesting
points.text: 用 but 和破折号把三个观察串成"好事—隐忧—代价"的递进。破折号后的内容是全文最重的一击，位置和标点都经过设计。

points.label: 比较级 + 形容词短语
points.text: became much better / more alike / less interesting 三个比较级并列，形式一致而语义反转，读起来有回声效果。alike 只能作表语，不能放在名词前（不能说 alike players）。

drill.prompt_zh: 用「长句铺垫 + 三个短句递进 + 破折号收尾」写两三句：自动翻译工具对学生的影响很奇怪。他们交上来的作业更准确了，但也越来越像——有些人已经不再自己动笔。
drill.answer: Machine translation has had a strange effect on students. Their assignments became more accurate, but they also became more alike—and some stopped writing on their own at all.

chunks.t: This raises all sorts of questions
about how progress will unfold in other fields
as they are transformed by AI.

sentences.skeleton: This raises questions about how progress will unfold in other fields.
sentences.zh: 这就引出了一连串问题：当其他领域也被 AI 改造时，那里的进步将以怎样的方式展开。

points.label: raise questions about + 疑问词从句
points.text: 英语议论文的万能过渡句式：This raises questions about how / whether / why...。同类动词：raise concerns about、cast doubt on、call into question。

points.label: unfold
points.text: unfold 原义"展开（折叠物）"，用于事件时＝"（逐渐）展开、演变"，比 happen 更强调过程性：as the crisis unfolded、how the story unfolds。

points.label: as 引导时间／伴随状语
points.text: as they are transformed by AI 里 as＝"随着、当……时"，同时暗含"两件事同步发生"。as 还有"因为"和"像"的意思，靠语境判断，这是英语里最需要小心的多义连词之一。

phrases.en: make of sth. (what to make of it)
phrases.note: 常用于否定或疑问：I don't know what to make of his reply.
衔接同类例证；vein 原义"矿脉、纹理"
描述竞争者互相跟进，通常独立成句放句首
引出与预期相反的事实，插入语位置灵活
It seems like only a matter of time before they reach that level.

phrases.zh: 更不用说（用于否定句后加强）
phrases.note: unimaginable a year ago, much less a decade ago；肯定句要用 let alone 或 still less
For all the advances in group theory, AI hasn't gotten far in the less theoretical sciences.
break out of a test environment / a slump / a routine
多个个体为共同目标结盟，略带非正式色彩
I might as well be the Journal's algebra correspondent. 自嘲语气
宾语是 idea / plan / solution / excuse，是 propose 的口语替代
否定式常用来点出"违规"：wasn't supposed to have internet access

quiz.q: "The move was so unconventional and ____ that nobody could be sure what to make of it." Which word means 'contrary to common sense'?
quiz.explain: counterintuitive＝反直觉的。counterproductive 是"适得其反的"，counterfeit 是"伪造的"，countervailing 是"抵消的"。四个词共用前缀 counter-（反、逆），但词根完全不同。

quiz.q: In "a placement so divine it became known as 'God's Touch'", the omitted word after "divine" is:
quiz.explain: 这是 so...that 结构，that 在非正式书面语中可省略。完整形式：a placement so divine that it became known as "God's Touch"。

quiz.q: "The reason I'm fascinated with the subject ____ that math has become proof of AI's speed." Which is correct in formal writing?
quiz.explain: The reason ... is that ... 是规范搭配。is because 在口语中常见，但正式写作视为冗余（reason 与 because 语义重复），考试和写作中应避免。

quiz.q: Hassabis says biology and chemistry are "very messy, very ____" — meaning their behavior arises from complex interactions and can't be predicted from the parts.
quiz.explain: emergent＝涌现的，指整体性质无法由局部推出。urgent 紧急的，eminent 著名的，imminent 即将发生的——四个词发音相近，是听力和拼写的高频陷阱。

quiz.q: "All of which was unimaginable a year ago, ____ a decade ago." Which phrase fits after a negative statement?
quiz.explain: much less 和 let alone 都表示"更不用说"，都用在否定语境后。原文用的是 much less；let alone 在此也成立，但选项中 much less 是原文表达，且更书面。

quiz.q: Why does the article argue math was the first field AI transformed?
options: Because mathematicians adopted AI tools earliest
Because math problems are shorter than scientific experiments
Because math is unusually verifiable, so AI can test and retry until it works
Because math requires no human intuition at all
quiz.explain: 文中明确说 math is unusually verifiable —— 规则精确、证明可逐步检验，因此 AI 可以"试一个想法、检验、学习、再试"。这也是它与 messy、emergent 的生物化学领域的分界线。

quiz.q: "The triumph of AlphaGo had a ____ effect on Go players: they got better but more alike."
quiz.explain: 单独使用的 peculiar＝奇特的、古怪的。peculiar to sth. 才是"某某特有的"，此处不接 to，故不能选 B。particular 和 specific 是"特定的"，不含"奇怪"之意。
